correctness.rationale: Uniform mechanical-word discrepancy and sublinear transition count establish R± exactly. Sparse edits give root count cn+o(log n), excluding the boundary eigen circle. Iterated Cauchy--Schwarz proves necessity for every eigenvector; disjoint side-tree constructions give infinite multiplicity. Radial forward shift localized on long upper/lower blocks produces a complete closed approximate-point annulus of the adjoint. Explicit bounded right inverse and spectral-radius formula exclude exterior annulus and yield exact surjectivity. Exact standalone finite rational checker completed 46,378 assertions; analytic proof does not infer infinite conclusions from those.

value.rationale: The initiating 2026 paper highlights intermediate-annulus spectrum as a natural open direction. This theorem realizes the entire ordered set of permissible logarithmic growth triples by unweighted trees with at most two children and determines exact point, approximate-point adjoint, and surjectivity strata. It establishes the nontrivial coexistence of infinite-dimensional eigenspaces with nonsurjectivity on a whole annulus, a structural separation between eigenvalue multiplicity and Caradus universality.
